focus: station-level queue progression: DRW / Unoenergy Driwe

operators.name: UNOENERGY DRIWE S.P.A.
operators.tariffChannel: DriWe app/card/direct remote payment; transaction fees depend on payment method; roaming kept separate
positiveEvidence: Current DriWe first-party App & Card page documents remote payment by VISA/PayPal and states transaction fees depend on payment method (credit card or coupon).
Current PUN-derived station evidence exposes IT*DRW EVSE under UNOENERGY DRIWE, including Schio Viale Tito Livio / Via Luzio: CCS 60 kW, CHAdeMO 50 kW and Type 2 22 kW.

A public DriWeNet station at Grand'Affi historically exposes a station-specific compound tariff (0.48 EUR/kWh + 0.01 EUR/min), proving that at least some DriWe charging prices can contain both energy and time components.
May 2026 PUN inventory reports UNOENERGY DRIWE S.P.A. at 267 active / 284 total points.
negativePaths: No current first-party deterministic Italy-wide AC/DC/HPC price grid was found.
The Grand'Affi 0.48 EUR/kWh + 0.01 EUR/min value is station-specific/legacy evidence and must not be generalized to other DRW EVSE.
Unoenergy domestic electricity/wallbox examples are not public CPO ad-hoc tariffs and must not be promoted.
Third-party roaming prices must not be substituted for the direct CPO/ad-hoc price.
operators.decision: Classify DRW as station-level/fail-closed. Do not promote a network-wide tariff. Resume only with deterministic IT*DRW station/EVSE -> current DriWe first-party app/payment tariff mapping or a newly published deterministic network rule.
operators.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*DRW station/EVSE -> current DriWe direct/app tariff payload

coherence.atlante: setAside-last and excluded from active count
coherence.doNotRepeat: Generic DRW network-wide tariff research is exhausted. Resume DRW only with a concrete IT*DRW EVSE and current first-party DriWe app/payment tariff payload, or a newly published deterministic Italy-wide rule.

history.change: DRW formally classified station-level: first-party payment model plus station-specific compound-price evidence rule out safe national extrapolation; no price promoted.
